title: Collections Platform Reference: Due-Date Extensions on an Accepted Hardship Settlement
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Granting a Due-Date Extension

## Subject of the rule

This rule fixes the Hardship Settlement extension days, the calendar days that one due-date extension adds to the next unpaid payment and every later payment of an accepted Hardship Settlement that is not in default and has used fewer than its two allowed extensions; extensions on any other programme are outside this rule. The Hardship Settlement is a programme of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements.

## What the extension waits on

Hardship Settlement extension days are granted only once the settlement shows status accepted with its acceptance date and first payment due date on record.

In the same terms: a Hardship Settlement that does not yet show status accepted, with an acceptance date and a first payment due date counted from that acceptance, receives no extension days.

## What the platform action does

`extend_hardship_settlement_due_dates_12bdc2d4` grants one due-date extension on an accepted Hardship Settlement. One call moves the next unpaid settlement payment and every later one later by the given number of calendar days: it adds one to the settlement's extension count, adds the days to the settlement's total extension days, and moves the final payment due date later by the same days; the settlement amount and the amount still to pay are unchanged. The consumer and the agent can see the new due dates on the settlement.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `extend_hardship_settlement_due_dates_12bdc2d4` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `settlement_id` | the settlement reference number of the accepted Hardship Settlement, as returned by the settlement lookup | identifier |
| `extension_days` | the number of calendar days the extension adds | whole integer of at least 1 |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: `settlement_id`; `extension_days` (integer, the days added by this call); `due_date_extension_count` (integer, extensions granted so far including this one); `extension_days_total` (integer, all days added by extensions); `first_payment_due_date_with_extensions` (YYYY-MM-DD, payment 1's due date after all extensions); `final_payment_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). A returned extension count means the extension is on record.

## Hypothetical receipt

On a hypothetical accepted Hardship Settlement with one earlier extension, a further call returns an extension count of 2 and an extension days total equal to the earlier days plus the days given in this call.
